intent: Generate the telemetry-ingestion-and-processing project root and build scaffold using the mcp-server-springboot skill (Java 17, Spring Boot 3, Maven, base package com.pulsestream.telemetry), with dependencies spring-boot-starter-webflux, spring-boot-starter-validation, spring-boot-starter-data-r2dbc, r2dbc-postgresql, flyway-core, postgresql, spring-boot-starter-jdbc, spring-boot-starter-test, reactor-test. Require: a SINGLE composition root (exactly one @SpringBootApplication class, never a second boot class); test-run timeout guardrails (maven-surefire-plugin per-test timeout and forkedProcessTimeoutInSeconds so a hung test fails fast); and a schema MIGRATION RUNNER wired into the build (Flyway with db/migration under src/main/resources, spring.flyway properties) because the persistence strategy owns SQL for the append-only telemetry ledger.
